ops.title: Phase 5–6 — the eval, then the gated async LLM lane
ops.description:
**Phase 5, before any LLM lane.** ~40 questions built from this repo's and the monorepo's own cc-notes history, with known supersession points, scored on MemBench's three axes (effectiveness / efficiency / capacity, arXiv:2506.21605), ≥5 seeded runs. Baselines that must be beaten: full-context injection and plain BM25. Every specialized memory system that was independently re-run either failed to reproduce or lost to a naive baseline — assume we will too until measured.

**Phase 6 ships only on a passing Phase 5.** `spawnllm` 0.10.0 is one Rust/WASM core with three bindings; the daemon drives the Go module `github.com/yasyf/spawnllm/go` directly, not the CLI. `--model small` maps to haiku / gpt-5.4-mini:low / gemini-2.5-flash-lite. `api_auth=False` by default strips API-key env vars so calls bill the logged-in subscription — hosted tiny-model calls are effectively unmetered here, which removes price from the decision and leaves only quality and latency.

1. **Local NER first, non-generative.** Concept nodes from a GLiNER/GLiREL-class encoder (50–300M, CPU-only, single forward pass, real ~50–60% F1 ceiling), or identifier regex where that suffices. The survey's cross-lane convergence: small *generative* models are the weak link for open-ended extraction; small *encoders* are not. Because there are no note→note edges and most monorepo notes are untagged, concept extraction is **the only thing that creates entity↔entity connectivity at all** — it recovers the untagged clusters (sandsql, pulumi-migration, repo-shrink) that make search return nothing today.
2. **Then narrow generative calls, A-MEM-shaped** — one decision each, over an embedding-prefiltered top-k, never a broad extraction: a cached write-time salience score (~10 output tokens, never recomputed); conflict adjudication over note pairs sharing an anchor with cosine > τ, emitting SUPERSEDE/NOOP, **proposed and never auto-applied**; injection compression of one hot cluster when the ranked slice overflows budget.
3. Every result written back as a cc-notes op per Phase 1's sync split. Every call issued by the daemon off a persisted queue, batched via `map_concurrent`, failures re-queued with backoff and otherwise invisible.

No offline mode, no env var (note `acd2aac`).

ops.text: >=40 questions across factual, multihop, temporal, cross-branch, abstention and staleness categories, with >=5 seeds
Full-context and BM25 baselines reported alongside every configuration
A network-denied run produces output identical to the online run minus enrichment, with zero errors surfaced
LLM calls per day measured and bounded
No LLM call on any read path
